target.title: Lean 4 Proof Check Demo: sorry-free arithmetic lemmas

tested: the Lean 4 project builds with `lake build` (when a toolchain is present)
the development contains no standalone `sorry` placeholders
optional existence of the named theorem PaperunitDemo.add_comm_demo
not_tested: scientific validity of the demo statements (they are core arithmetic lemmas)
whether the Lean development matches any real paper's definitions
any Lean file or claim outside this fixture directory
on a machine without a Lean toolchain, nothing is tested and the claim must be INCONCLUSIVE

claims.text: The Lean 4 formalisation in lean_project builds and its proofs contain no `sorry` placeholders.
claims.reason: Lean build succeeded ('lake build', exit 0) and no `sorry` placeholders were found.

evidence.trust_model: A failed Lean build means the audit's formalisation did not go through; it is not evidence against the paper's claim and not evidence of misconduct. Only a successful proof check can support the claim.

limits: scientific validity of the demo statements (they are core arithmetic lemmas)
whether the Lean development matches any real paper's definitions
any Lean file or claim outside this fixture directory
on a machine without a Lean toolchain, nothing is tested and the claim must be INCONCLUSIVE
An audit tests only the listed claims on the stated commit in the stated environment; it is not a verdict on the paper's scientific value, and it carries no aggregate score.
